long_biography.plain_text:
At Hong Kong contractor Geotech, businessman Chen Zhi proposed taking the company’s construction experience into Cambodia. After becoming its controlling shareholder and chairman, he identified opportunities in site preparation, building and interior decoration. His plans also included property management in Hong Kong, where he anticipated demand from additional homes and commercial premises.

Geotech subsequently provided services to a commercial property held through Chen’s wholly owned company Cheer Capital. Geotech’s subsidiary Nova undertook management consultancy, then agreed to provide leasing services for existing or referred tenants. The agency remit covered enquiries, site visits and lease negotiations, followed by preparation of the tenancy agreements.
